name: Re-run of MicroDuck Arena Hill Climb files finds most top entries solve only the five scored starts
title: Re-run of MicroDuck Arena Hill Climb files finds most top entries solve only the five scored starts
summary: After re-running all 129 public files on the Arena's own scorer (all matched board times), the author reports 25 of the top 30 ducks finish fewer than half of 20 other starts. A duck trained on Pollen's shipped recipe on one RTX 5090 climbs the 1.5 m slope in 4.93 s, upright on all 25 starts.
